evidence.title: Norway wealth fund sounds alarm on AI stock market bubble

occurrences.checkable_against: Norway's Government Pension Fund Global investment strategy and asset-allocation records
occurrences.quote_span: Unlike Saudi Arabia or Singapore's sovereign wealth funds, which make large investments in private equity, infrastructure and real estate, Norway largely follows a benchmark-based investment strategy by buying index funds that track major global markets.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Berkshire Hathaway quarterly balance sheet
occurrences.quote_span: Berkshire is currently sitting on around $365 billion in cash and short-term Treasuries.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Commercial real estate and office-sector performance indexes since 2020
occurrences.quote_span: Commercial real estate has underperformed since the COVID-19 pandemic, especially the office sector.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Norges Bank Investment Management derivatives positions and risk-management reports
occurrences.quote_span: Capape said, noting that Norges Bank Investment Management, a unit at the central bank that manages the country's sovereign wealth fund, also uses currency, interest-rate and equity derivatives to protect against a crash.
occurrences.speaker: Javier Capape
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Government Pension Fund Global strategic benchmark allocation
occurrences.quote_span: Javier Capape, a Madrid-based sovereign wealth fund specialist, thinks Norway is "unusually exposed" through its investment strategy of roughly 70% equities and 30% bonds.
occurrences.speaker: Javier Capape
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Norway's 2026 projected North Sea oil and gas revenue inflows
occurrences.quote_span: In 2026, this is projected to be the equivalent of €63 billion.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Bank for International Settlements June 2026 warning or report on AI exuberance
occurrences.quote_span: The Bank for International Settlements warned in June that AI "exuberance" risks ending in a bust if returns fall short of expectations.
occurrences.speaker: Bank for International Settlements
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Norwegian government budget financing records and Government Pension Fund Global transfers
occurrences.quote_span: During what Tangen called an "abnormal" period of low taxes, low inflation and low interest rates, the investments now finance roughly a quarter of the Norwegian government's budget.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Norwegian Government Pension Fund Global investment mandate and cash holdings
occurrences.quote_span: A strict government mandate means the Norwegian fund cannot take significant protective positions, including holding large amounts of cash.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Norwegian Government Pension Fund Global investment mandate and benchmark-deviation records
occurrences.quote_span: Although this approach "eliminates a lot of the uncertainty of picking individual stocks," Thorburn said Norway's GPFG fund managers have "almost no room to deviate from the index or actively hedge."
occurrences.speaker: Karin Thorburn
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Nvidia, Amazon and Microsoft historical share-price records for June-August 2026
occurrences.quote_span: After a sharp pullback in June and July, many AI-related stocks have rebounded, with Nvidia, Amazon and Microsoft rising in the double digits in recent weeks.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Private equity fund withdrawal and redemption notices
occurrences.quote_span: Some private equity funds have temporarily suspended or limited investor withdrawals due to a severe liquidity squeeze.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Published cost and capability comparisons for Chinese and US AI models
occurrences.quote_span: China , meanwhile, is developing capable AI models at a fraction of the cost of their rivals in the United States .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Nvidia partnership announcements and Wall Street firms' AI infrastructure financing commitments
occurrences.quote_span: Nvidia has partnered with six Wall Street firms to boost spending on AI infrastructure by more than $500 billion
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Nicolai Tangen's remarks on the potential effect of an AI-market correction on the GPFG
occurrences.quote_span: A sharp correction, he warned, could potentially erase much of the massive wealth built up over the past 30 years.
occurrences.speaker: Nicolai Tangen
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Nicolai Tangen's warning or remarks about AI-chip valuations and the GPFG
occurrences.quote_span: Yet, Tangen warned that the AI-chip trade — whose lofty valuations helped drive those gains — now poses a serious risk.
occurrences.speaker: Nicolai Tangen
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Institutional investor derivatives and hedging records
occurrences.quote_span: Most institutional investors, on the other hand, hedge by buying options or futures, which rise in value when regular investments like stocks drop, offsetting some of the declines.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Bill Megginson's statement to DW about fund managers and AI capital spending
occurrences.quote_span: Few managers are inclined to take profits when such a fundamental technology buildout, fueled by literally unprecedented levels of capital spending, shows little evidence of brittleness,
occurrences.speaker: Bill Megginson
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Nicolai Tangen's public remarks on the Government Pension Fund Global's market-collapse exposure
occurrences.quote_span: Nicolai Tangen, CEO of Norway's Government Pension Fund Global (GPFG), warned last week that, in an extreme market collapse, a massive loss to its $2.4 trillion (€2.07 trillion) portfolio is "not completely improbable."
occurrences.speaker: Nicolai Tangen
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Government Pension Fund Global asset allocation report
occurrences.quote_span: Technology accounts for roughly a third of the fund's stock investments.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Major technology companies' announced AI infrastructure capital expenditure plans
occurrences.quote_span: Major technology companies are expected to invest more than $1 trillion in AI-related infrastructure like chips , data centers and power infrastructure in the race to match or beat human intelligence.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen

occurrences.checkable_against: Analyst forecasts for AI stock prices and AI stock historical highs
occurrences.quote_span: Some analysts now expect AI stocks to reach new all-time highs by the end of the year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Nicolai Tangen
